thread:
Renee: quick check  we need daypart caps + negative keyword sweep before the promo goes live tomorrow 06:00 PT. goal: stable CPL, avoid expensive night clicks.
Omar: agree. propose daypart windows: peak 08:00-20:00 local, night throttle 20:00-08:00 at -60% bids. set `max_daypart_pct=0.18` for peak hours.
Lila: for keywords I've pulled last 90d terms, will append a negative list for low-intent queries (free, tutorial, how to). sending file.
Devon: CRM update: route leads from paid_search > campaign=may_wave to SDR Pool A if `mql_score >= 70`, otherwise staging queue for nurture. webhook endpoint: `https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-router/v1`.
Renee: thanks. also want to test sitelink combinations vs no-sitelinks to see CTR lift. run 30% traffic with sitelinks enabled.
Omar: bidding plan: three keyword tiers (high intent exact, mid intent phrase, broad discovery). cap CPA targets: $35 / $50 / $75 respectively. dynamic bids only within 15% band.
Lila: creative refresh plan: rotate hero message every 6 hours, swap creative group if CTR down > 25% over rolling 4h. add localized copy for UK (GBP mention) and AU (AEST daypart).
Devon: mapping confirmation: payload will include utm_campaign, keyword, creative_token and `lead_score`. will return 200/OK with routing tag. devs confirm retry logic 3x.
Renee: AdOps  can you implement negative keywords and daypart caps? Also reserve 10% of daily budget as buffer for peak hours across geos.
AdOps Bot: negative keyword list uploaded (file: negative_128_may.csv). daypart caps and bid multipliers scheduled. buffer budget rule created: `reserve_pct=0.10` across accounts redwood-prod-ads.
Omar: small experiment: enable conversion window lag compensation for search (lookback 7d) to avoid premature pause on keywords with delayed conversions.
Lila: added token values for creative: `hero_launch`, `hero_value`, `hero_trust`, plus `sitelink_demo`, `sitelink_pricing`.
Devon: CRM Webhook: health check OK. will tag routed leads with `route:SDR-A` or `route:nurture`.
Renee: pause rule: auto-pause any keyword group where CPA > 2x target for 2h AND spend > $200. who owns the monitoring?
Omar: I'll watch first 6 hours, set alerts to #paid-ops and DM on-call.
AdOps Bot: alerting hooks created: #paid-ops, dm->Omar. automated pause policy added for keyword groups.
Lila: note on reporting: GA event `paid_lead` will include `creative_token` so we can trace which sitelink combos drive leads. pushing dashboard schema.
Devon: reminder  tag all routed leads with `origin=paid_search_maywave` so we can filter in Salesforce.
Renee: launch checklist: negative list in, daypart caps deployed, reserve budget set, creative tokens mapped, webhook routing live, dashboard flagged. go/no-go in 45m.
Omar: small tweak: for UK campaign use bid floor adjustment -5% during local lunch 12:00-13:00.
Lila: creative upload done. images named `may_hero_A_us.jpg` etc.
AdOps Bot: deployment complete. daypart throttle active at 05:58 PT. all systems nominal.
Renee: perfect. keep updates very short (time / metric). we'll reconvene 3 hours post-launch for readout.
CRM Webhook: test lead accepted and routed -> route:SDR-A (id: lr_20240512_334).
